# ArkSignal: public release notes and roadmap

This repository holds the two files that the [ArkSignal portal](https://arksignal.net) reads live to show its public **Release Notes** and **Roadmap** pages:

- `release_notes.json`: what each version added, improved, fixed and secured
- `roadmap.json`: what is coming next, in progress, planned and just released

**Do not edit these files here.** They are published automatically from the project's working copy every time the lists change, and with every release, so the pages on the site stay current while work is under way. The files contain only public, plain-language information.

The portal itself is open source: [ArkSignal/ArkSignal-Portal](https://github.com/ArkSignal/ArkSignal-Portal).
